approval: Delegated by the user's request to design and begin building, then corrected by the explicit AdsPower reference.
translationNotes: Keep the narrow icon rail, large title, wide search, action hierarchy, airy table rows, and vivid royal-blue primary actions.
Keep one continuous main content column; dialogs and temporary side drawers are allowed, persistent left-right content splits are not.
Do not copy AdsPower branding, logos, proprietary browser names, or features RealBrowser has not implemented.
Platform logos and store names in the generated comp are illustrative only and must not ship in the local-first empty state.
